اجتليا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَلَيَا (ijtalayā) /id͡ʒ.ta.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# اُجْتُلِيَا (ujtuliyā) /ud͡ʒ.tu.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# اِجْتَلِيَا (ijtaliyā) /id͡ʒ.ta.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
